raw_text: PLAN Type 055 destroyer now in the Indian Ocean. This is a 13,000-ton cruiser-class warship with 112 VLS cells making its second IOR deployment in 2024. India has responded by deploying P-8I Poseidon surveillance aircraft. The frequency of these deployments is increasing — China is building a pattern of presence in India's backyard.
clean_text: PLAN Type 055 in Indian Ocean, second IOR deployment in 2024. India deploying P-8I. China building pattern of presence in Indian Ocean.
